datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on September 22, 2025
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of September 22, 2025, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20250922]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map actual flood extent across the Philippines following tropical cyclone impacts on September 22, 2025. The resulting flood boundary polygons and raster maps represent observed inundation areas derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and optical satellite data, enabling temporal tracking of flood progression and spatial assessment of affected areas.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing and analysis to delineate actual flood extent and inundation areas from tropical cyclone-induced flooding events
